score_tradeoff.purpose: Weighted sum of the person's ratings on a 0–100 scale, with ±10-point weight robustness. Never names a winner.

data.label: Your own weights and ratings, added up. This does not choose for you.
data.normalization: weights / sum(|weights|); each rating maps to 0–100 on the scale; lower_better criteria invert as (max+min−value) before mapping

procedure: Require ≥2 options (id/name) and criteria each with a numeric weight ≥0 and at least one weight >0.
Require ratings cells with a named rater; every option×criterion must have a value for that rater or emit rating_missing and do not score that rater.
Map rating v on scale [lo,hi] to 0–100: if direction is lower_better, v ← hi+lo−v; then ((v−lo)/(hi−lo))*100.
Rank options by total descending (then name). If top two totals differ by ≤ tie_tolerance, note a tie — person decides. Never say a winner.

Robustness: total weight W; span = 0.10×W. For each criterion, shift its weight up/down by up to span (clamped), rescale other weights so sum stays W. If another option overtakes the baseline top, record smallest_shift_points. top_option_holds = no such changes.
Stamp the run as FOCUSED / tradeoff-score: not tool-checked (method only) unless the person already stamped otherwise.
